Method of Attack: Malicious code embedded in APKPure app decrypts and launches payload on app launch
Collects user device information and sends it to C&C server
Loads Trojan similar to Triada malware capable of displaying and clicking ads, signing up for paid subscriptions, and downloading other malware
Shows ads every time device is unlocked
Repeatedly opens web pages containing ads
Clicks ads to sign up for paid subscriptions
Installs other payloads or potentially malicious software without user consent
Deploys unremovable malware like xHelper on system partition on some Android versions
Attack Vector: Malicious advertisement SDK embedded within APKPure app version 3.7.18
Indicators of Compromise: APKPure app version 3.7.18 containing malicious advertisement SDK
Payload and malware sample hashes available in Kaspersky's report
Malware blocked on 9,380 Android devices running Kaspersky security solutions
